preconditions.description: The number of integers n is between 1 and 32768, inclusive.
Each integer a_i is between 0 and 32767, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output list contains n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= output[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output list is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == min_operations(a_i) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is the minimum number of operations required to make the corresponding input integer equal to 0.
